evasive.d: +25 evasion until your next turn and +2 movement now.

reload.d: Torpedo tubes are ready to fire again immediately.

focus.d: All of this ship’s weapons deal +30% damage this turn.

launch.d: Carriers start each battle with their wings in flight. This launches a replacement for a lost wing into an adjacent hex; each carrier has one spare wing per hangar slot.

surge.d: Every shield facing restored to full strength.

nova.d: Spinal shell: 40 damage to a hex 3–9 away and 20 to everything adjacent. Hits friends too.

ionpulse.d: Every enemy ship within 4 hexes loses half of each shield facing.

overburn.d: +3 movement now, and a ram this turn hits 50% harder.

frenzy.d: All of this ship’s weapons deal +30% damage this turn.

regrow.d: Regrow 25% of this ship’s hull right now.

blink.d: Jump to any open hex within 3, straight past rocks and ships. Tap the hex.

phase.d: +25 evasion until your next turn and +2 movement now.

reclaim.d: Restore 20% hull to your most damaged ship within 3 hexes (this one included).
